meta.name: D - first deposit into zsUSDG (4.500000)
meta.description: approve 4500000 USDG units (4.500000 USDG) to the vault, then deposit them with the Safe as receiver. Mints 4.500000 zsUSDG at parity; previewRedeem round-trips exactly, so there is no rounding loss. Re-cut from the original full-balance 4.925501 so that batch F (which needs a round 100.000000 USDG) fits alongside it: the Safe holds 104.667567 USDG, F takes 100.000000, and this takes 4.500000, leaving 0.167567. Verified on a mainnet fork: deposit lands, _pushToAdapter forwards it into Steakhouse in the same transaction so it earns immediately, and a full redeem returns the principal to the unit. One batch rather than two transactions so it consumes a single Safe nonce. NOTE: Safe nonces execute in order -- the treasury handover is the other thing waiting on one.
